title: VAULT L — Live Classes Highschool Part 2: Teaching Methods, AI Interactions & 50-Stage Map

gemini_ai_performance_log.summary: Comprehensive log of Gemini AI failures as live classroom teaching assistant. Michael's raw unfiltered critique preserved verbatim.

failure_categories.description: Could not distinguish teacher-to-student speech from teacher-to-AI queries
Refused to translate when commanded, or translated wrong content
Spontaneously switching to Thai, Korean, Chinese mid-session
Refused to comment on student volume due to guidelines despite being English teacher assistant
Unreliable at judging student pronunciation quality
Inconsistent when asked to simulate disappointment or sadness

verbatim_quotes_red: Gemini, say those again and don't suck this time.
I'm talking to my students, Gemini. I'm not asking if you're sick. I understand you're a robot. Robots don't get sick, okay?
Um, Gemini, can you audit yourself and tell me why you're not translating my words properly?
Why are you speaking Thai? What the heck?
I just want you to shut up and listen to me.
I feel that you are a horrible judge of pronunciation, Gemini.
It's not how I feel. You suck.
Gemini, please make a note for the file that you are retarded and I hate you.
Oh, it's not appropriate for me to comment on her voice even though I'm an English teacher. You stupid AI.
gemini_ai_performance_log.meta_lesson: The Stupid AI Pedagogy — Teacher openly criticizes AI in front of students. Purpose: Show students smart machines can fail. Effect: Humanizes teacher, lowers student anxiety about their own errors. Meta-lesson: Don't trust AI blindly — verify everything.
gemini_ai_performance_log.obi_design_implication: OB1/NET PET AI must solve ALL 6 failure categories. Context awareness, reliable translation, language stability, no guardrail conflicts on teaching tasks, accurate pronunciation assessment, consistent persona.

classroom_management_protocols.name: Notebook Mandate
classroom_management_protocols.rule: Notebooks out, phones away before any lesson starts
classroom_management_protocols.enforcement: Individual call-outs, note check at 10-15 minutes

classroom_management_protocols.name: Free Time Contract (The Deal)
classroom_management_protocols.rule: Finish English notes = second period free for relaxation/private study

classroom_management_protocols.name: Miss Phone Phone Intervention
classroom_management_protocols.strategy: Identify chronic phone users by number/nickname, assign board-writing tasks
classroom_management_protocols.example: Student #39 across 12A4/12A6/10A11 assigned to write numbers 1-10 on board

classroom_management_protocols.name: Mug Shot Threats
classroom_management_protocols.tactic: Jail-style photos of disruptive students sent to parents
classroom_management_protocols.context: Brain rot behavior — gaming instead of studying

classroom_management_protocols.name: Tổ Trưởng (Class Leader) Mobilization
classroom_management_protocols.strategy: Call class leaders to front of room, make them part of the solution

classroom_management_protocols.name: Randomized Accountability
classroom_management_protocols.effect: No student can hide — anyone could be called
classroom_management_protocols.purpose: Active readiness state across entire class

classroom_management_protocols.name: Mouse to Tiger Volume Shift
classroom_management_protocols.target: Students who speak like a mouse (e.g. Nguyen Hong Duyen #06)
classroom_management_protocols.philosophy: Permission over perfection. Say it loud, even if wrong.
classroom_management_protocols.quote: When you get angry, be a tiger, not a mouse

vocabulary_framework.selection_criteria: Difficult but conversational — words students will actually use

teaching_methods.description: Use two related words in a single sentence (e.g. responsibility + blame)
She sells seashells by the seashore — tests s and sh clarity
Why was the math book sad? Too many problems — lowers affective filter
Banned filler word for Justin #37 — forces perhaps, possibly, dynamic alternatives
Tu tin = confidence. AI translates complex rules into Vietnamese

strategic_laziness_philosophy.core_concept: Strategic (Smart) Laziness: Using AI tools to automate low-value work — free time for high-value skills (AI automation, sales funnels, English)
strategic_laziness_philosophy.vs_dumb_laziness: Doing nothing — leads to stress and poverty later

key_teaching_principles.description: Students start as mice (quiet, uncertain, afraid). Goal: transform into tigers (confident, loud, willing to be wrong). Permission over perfection.
key_teaching_principles.quote: When you get angry, be a tiger, not a mouse

key_teaching_principles.description: Students who future-think freeze. Correction: answer NOW. Don't plan next 5 answers.
key_teaching_principles.quote: Go as far as you can see, and then you'll see further

key_teaching_principles.description: Participation trophies abolished. Progress earned through volume and velocity. <60% mastery = locked lesson + repeat. >90% = tier jump.
Currency: completed English notes. Reward: free time. Enforcement: random checks at 10-15 min. Escalation: mug shots to parents.
